metadata.niche_title: Practical AI Agent Engineering — How Coding Agents Work, Fail & Get Fixed

requirements.requirement: Niche status must be LOCKED_BY_OWNER with allow_agent_niche_discovery=false, allow_agent_niche_switch=false, and allow_agent_edit_policy=false.
requirements.evidence: Policy validator verifies status==LOCKED_BY_OWNER and rejects dynamic edits.

requirements.requirement: Topics must belong strictly to one of the 5 allowed families: context_memory, agent_tool_use, debugging_reliability, agent_evaluation, agent_architecture. Off-niche topics must be rejected.
requirements.evidence: FixedNicheScopeGate works in lib/fixed_niche/gate.py and passes 68 tests, but is not invoked by tools/news/news_pipeline_cli.py or scripts/run_daily_news_pipeline.sh.

requirements.requirement: insufficient_topic_action must be NO_ELIGIBLE_TOPIC and never_force_daily_quota=true. No fallback to another niche.
requirements.evidence: Fixed niche runner respects NO_ELIGIBLE_TOPIC, but scripts/retry_daily_pipeline.sh hardcodes EXPECTED_SUCCESS_COUNT=3 and retries hourly.

requirements.requirement: Shorts target duration strictly locked to [65.0, 75.0] seconds. Speech and rendered MP4 must be within this bound.
requirements.evidence: edge-tts rate retry and ffmpeg atempo fine-tuning ensure speech and MP4 duration fall in [65.0, 74.5]s.

requirements.requirement: Longform is initially disabled (longform.enabled_initially: false). Daily pipeline should produce 9:16 portrait Shorts only.
requirements.evidence: run_daily_news_pipeline.sh unconditionally renders final_long_en_US_16x9.mp4 alongside final_short_en_US_9x16.mp4.

requirements.requirement: Videos must contain >=6 semantically distinct visual beats; no single scene or beat can hold longer than 12.0 seconds.
requirements.evidence: lib/news_visual/qa.py strictly checks HTML scene hold times and beat durations <=12.0s.

requirements.requirement: Post-render frame sampling must verify actual visual content from decoded video frames (contrast, std-dev, MAD pixel movement, scene transitions) rather than relying on HTML references alone.
requirements.evidence: lib/news_visual/qa.py decodes upper 80% gray frames with ffmpeg, checks std-dev and MAD, but does not yet evaluate semantic claim alignment.

requirements.requirement: Primary evidence must be derived from official docs, changelogs, repositories, or verified research. Claim ledger must substantiate figures and statements without self-generated synthetic snapshots.
requirements.evidence: scripts/bind_news_evidence.py fabricates timestamps and writes local source_evidence_s*.txt from research_brief.json text, and approves claims on 2-token overlap.

requirements.requirement: Captions must be generated from final audio, positioned in safe bottom zone, monotonic, seek-safe, and burned in or HTML-clip synchronized.
requirements.evidence: install_news_captions.py uses whisper/faster-whisper ASR on final narration.mp3, produces monotonic cues, and validates overlay safe zones.

requirements.requirement: Cryptographic release manifests must be signed with HMAC-SHA256 supervisor keys bound to media, claim ledger, metadata, captions, and script hashes.
requirements.evidence: lib/qa_signing.py verifies supervisor key and validates SHA256 hashes of all release artifacts before approval.

requirements.requirement: Publishing schedule must enforce >=2 hours spacing, queue deduplication before slot allocation, idempotent retries, and clean project directories only after verified publication.
requirements.evidence: schedule_today_native.py and cleanup_published_projects.py pass 76 tests. However, schedule_youtube_today.py does not deduplicate active_projects before slot modulo assignment.
